description: Restyles an existing video clip with an art-style preset or a custom prompt. Supports v1/v2 presets, not v3. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. For attached ChatGPT files, upload with upload_chatgpt_media and pass its returned file_path. Reuse existing Magic Hour paths only from the connected account. Do not pass a filename, chat-local path or file ID as a file path.

assets.description: Provide the assets for video-to-video. For video, The `video_source` field determines whether `video_file_path` or `youtube_url` field is used

initial_image_path.description: Required for v3: an uploaded reference image path, or a completed image output owned by you. The caller supplies this image; the API does not generate it.

video_file_path.description:
Your video file. Required if `video_source` is `file`. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

fps.description: Source video FPS for v3 frame limits and estimated credits. Defaults to 30; final charges settle to rendered frames.

fps_resolution.description:
Determines whether the resulting video will have the same frame per second as the original video, or half.
* `FULL` - the result video will have the same FPS as the input video
* `HALF` - the result video will have half the FPS as the input video

height.description: Source video height in integer pixels. Required and positive for v3; ignored for v1/v2.

name.description: Give your video a custom name for easy identification.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

model.description: Select a listed rendering model for the art style. `default` uses the selected art style's default model.

prompt.description: The prompt used for the video. Prompt is required if `prompt_type` is `custom` or `append_default`. If `prompt_type` is `default`, then the `prompt` value passed will be ignored.
prompt.example: A cinematic scene with warm lighting

prompt_type.description: `default` uses the art style's preset prompt and ignores `prompt`. `custom` uses the supplied `prompt`; v1 still adds its LoRA prompt to apply the art style. `append_default` appends the preset prompt to the supplied `prompt`.

version.description: Select restyling version `v1` or `v2`. `default` uses the selected art style's default version. Some styles default to v3, which this API does not support. For `Studio Ghibli`, explicitly set `version` to `v2` for its supported preset.

width.description: Source video width in integer pixels. Required and positive for v3; ignored for v1/v2.

name: restyle_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.

title: Restyle video
